sentinel.description: Read-only local clone of vulnwatch/sentinel: the backend, its domain and API contract specifications, and client obligations. Read it as AGENTS.md (Sentinel as an External Authority) requires; never modify it.

spec.description: Writes and maintains UI specifications, project policy, and OpenCode configuration. Cannot modify implementation code.

code.description: Implements the UI from its issue, foundation documents, and Sentinel's contract. Signals unresolved behavioral or contract gaps while choosing compliant internal technical mechanisms.
